'''Kiri''' was a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], alongside [[Lina Lascol]], [[Lartan]], [[Mox Freedan]], and [[Ezak]]. The younglings were members of [[Wolf Clan]],<ref name="CSWE Clan" /> one of several [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clans]] that young Jedi were placed in when beginning their Jedi training<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. The [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]<ref name="CSWE Clan" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CSWE Temple">{{CSWECite|II|152|Jedi Temple}}</ref> was both the location of Wolf Clan's living quarters and training facilities.<ref name="CSWE Clan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kiri was mentioned in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE Clan" />
